provenance_summary: V1-B biological expansion wave. Plant epicuticular wax structures providing superhydrophobicity and self-cleaning properties, biomimetically applied for oil-water separation and anti-fouling surfaces.

mechanisms.description: Epicuticular wax crystal structure: micro/nano hierarchical wax crystals on plant leaf surfaces create superhydrophobic surface (WCA >150°) via Cassie-Baxter state
mechanisms.description_en: Epicuticular wax crystal structure: micro/nano hierarchical wax crystals on plant leaf surfaces create superhydrophobic surface (WCA >150°) via Cassie-Baxter state

bio_structure.text: Epicuticular wax crystals (long-chain alkanes, esters, fatty acids)

interaction.text: Superhydrophobicity from hierarchical micro/nano wax crystal structure
interaction.scope_match: Keywords: micro, nano, superhydrophobicity, structure, hierarchical

causal_chain.transferable_principle: Epicuticular wax hierarchical micro/nano structure creates superhydrophobic surface for oil-water separation
causal_chain.transferable_principle_en: Epicuticular wax hierarchical micro/nano structure creates superhydrophobic surface for oil-water separation

mechanisms.name: 植物表皮蜡质微纳层级晶体超疏水
mechanisms.name_en: Superhydrophobicity of hierarchical micro/nano wax crystals on plant epidermis

engineering_constraints.description: Wax extraction: solvent extraction or thermal separation from plant leaves

narrative.text: Plant epicuticular wax creates superhydrophobic surfaces through hierarchical micro/nano structures. This natural design inspires oil-water separation membranes and anti-fouling coatings.

design_translation.idea: Mimic plant epicuticular wax hierarchical structure for superhydrophobic oil-water separation and anti-fouling applications
design_translation.design_principle: Plant cuticle wax provides hydrophobic surface for oil-water separation and organic pollutant removal
design_translation.implementation_example: Lotus leaf-inspired superhydrophobic coating; Rice leaf-inspired directional water transport
design_translation.constraints: Wax layer fragile; limited to hydrophobic interactions; not suitable for heavy metal adsorption
